blogs.title: Why LLMs Still Stumble on Long Docs – and How LongRoPE Fixes It
blogs.description: A lay‑person’s guide to the core problem of limited context windows in large language models, the pitfalls of naïve positional tricks, and the breakthrough ideas behind LongRoPE that let models read more than two million tokens without losing accuracy.

blogs.title: The Secret Sauce: Non‑Uniform Positional Interpolation Explained
blogs.description: Dive into the two hidden non‑uniformities (RoPE dimensions and token positions) that LongRoPE exploits, why earlier methods like PI, NTK, and YaRN fall short, and how an evolutionary search finds the perfect rescaling factors for each dimension.

blogs.title: From 4K to 2 048K Tokens – Inside LongRoPE’s Progressive Fine‑Tuning Strategy
blogs.description: Walk through the step‑by‑step “progressive extension” pipeline: stretching a model to 256 K with a tiny fine‑tuning budget, then using a second positional interpolation to reach 2 048 K tokens, all while keeping GPU costs manageable.

blogs.title: Benchmarks That Matter: How LongRoPE Performs on Real‑World Long‑Context Tasks
blogs.description: Summarize the experimental results—perplexity on PG19 and Proof‑Pile, passkey retrieval at million‑token scales, and standard QA benchmarks—showing that extending the context window doesn’t compromise performance on shorter tasks.

blogs.title: Practical Tips for Applying LongRoPE to Your Own Models
blogs.description: A hands‑on tutorial for researchers and engineers: setting up the evolutionary search, choosing hyper‑parameters, fine‑tuning shortcuts, and integrating LongRoPE into existing RoPE‑based LLMs such as LLaMA 2 or Mistral.
